what_it_is: Planet Labs PBC is the San Francisco-based earth-observation company operating the largest commercial imaging-satellite fleet (Dove/SuperDove, SkySat, Pelican lines), selling daily-scan imagery and analytics globally including to governments and agricultural, mapping and intelligence customers.
india_angle: Planet maintains India-specific commercial materials and its imagery is widely used in Indian agricultural analytics and mapping markets; a formal Indian government satellite-data contract is not publicly documented. Its India significance in this atlas is as the global benchmark against which Indian private EO entrants are measured.
intelligence_assessment: Planet's global record is exceptionally well documented; India-specific contractual evidence is not. Track any IN-SPACe/ISRO or Indian ministry data agreements as the signal that would upgrade its India file.

faq.q: Does Planet operate satellites over India?
faq.a: Planet's global daily-scan constellation covers Indian territory like any landmass; India-specific data agreements are not publicly documented.
